subject: Cloud Computing
title: Marketplace and Ecosystem Wars
description: A quick win: understand Marketplace and Ecosystem Wars.

hook.text: AWS Marketplace lists over 15,000 third-party products. Want a firewall? Database? AI model? One click.

buildup.text: Cloud marketplaces let vendors sell directly to cloud customers. Billing runs through the cloud provider.

discovery.text: This matters for procurement. Marketplace purchases count against existing cloud contracts and commitments.

twist.text: Vendors pay 15–20% commissions to be listed. It's the App Store model applied to enterprise software.

climax.text: The richer the marketplace, the stickier the cloud. It's another layer of ecosystem lock-in.

punchline.text: Cloud marketplaces: convenient for buyers, profitable for platforms.

quiz.question: Why do cloud marketplaces benefit the cloud provider?
options: They add ecosystem stickiness and earn commissions on every sale
Cloud providers get free software from all marketplace vendors
Marketplace products are always cheaper than buying directly

details.summary: Cloud marketplaces let customers purchase third-party software through their cloud provider's billing system. AWS, Azure, and Google all operate marketplaces where thousands of vendors sell software, creating ecosystems that increase provider stickiness and simplify enterprise procurement.
details.whyItMatters: Cloud marketplaces are becoming the primary way enterprises purchase software. Providers who build the strongest marketplace ecosystems capture more customer spending and increase switching costs.
takeaways: Marketplaces let vendors sell through cloud provider billing
Enterprise procurement is simplified by consolidated purchasing
Marketplace spending counts toward cloud commitment discounts

faq.question: Why do enterprises buy through cloud marketplaces?
faq.answer: Marketplace purchases consolidate into the cloud bill, simplifying procurement and accounting. Spending counts toward committed use discounts. Pre-vetted security and compliance reduce evaluation effort. One-click deployment eliminates installation complexity.

faq.question: How do vendors benefit from cloud marketplaces?
faq.answer: Vendors gain access to the cloud provider's massive customer base without building their own sales infrastructure. Co-selling programs pair vendor products with cloud sales teams. Marketplace transactions reduce the friction of enterprise sales cycles significantly.
